label: Actual esse CAUSE_2 is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1, via distinct actual dependence (inference)
rule: Discharge the scoped route's antecedents at a distinct cause of an actual concretum's esse
meaning: If c, distinct from the actual concretum x, causes x's esse, then x depends for its being on c (OPEN reading of q.44 a.1 ad 2 for causes of esse), c exists at w (OPEN) and is concrete (OPEN causal-capacity reading), so both are actual concreta and the scoped dependence-to-priority route makes c simply prior to x. This is a second derivation of the #1604 esse-cause priority node, through dependence for being rather than through the esse-cause-is-ground bridge; it uses the same bridge content as that node's route through STMT-ESSE-CAUSE-IS-ACTUAL-CONCRETE-GROUND derived via dependence. All dependence instances it uses have distinct relata. Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
